approvedBy: Claude editorial review, authorized by the owner on 2026-09-25
firstPlayerRule: Everyone rolls the 6 black dice. Whoever rolls the most Smash (claw) results goes first.
officialTieBreak: If players tie, they roll dice again until one player has the most Smash results.

sources.title: King of Tokyo — English rulebook
sources.location: Start of How to Play, above the Turn Overview; credits and copyright on PDF page 7

internalEvidence: The IELLO-hosted English rulebook (linked from https://iellogames.com/games/king-of-tokyo/) was unreachable from this network on 2026-09-25, so the identical URL was retrieved through the Internet Archive (id_ raw capture). SHA-256 8ad8bba7f868b3925bb82ba206bd5cc8eab9a1c5d08e2b36fccad615af57e5fe. PDF page 4 was rendered and visually checked: each player rolls the 6 black dice, whoever has the most claw-icon results goes first, and ties roll until one player has the greatest number. The same page labels the claw icon Smash. PDF page 7 shows ©2011-2023 IELLO, Richard Garfield design, lot KOTEN112023. BGG 70323. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
uncertainty: The rulebook does not say whether only the tied players reroll.
King of Tokyo: Dark Edition and Origins were not checked.
